title: Changelog
subtitle: What changed in JKNet, grouped by release.

entries.v0_10_0_webApp: Chat with friends from your phone or any browser: sign in at online.jknet.app and add JKNet to your home screen.
entries.v0_10_0_signIn: Browser sign-in is now bound to the launcher that started it, so a sign-in link someone else sends you can no longer hand them your account.
entries.v0_10_0_attachments: The chat attachment menu is split into files, media, game data, settings and catalogs. Maps, configs and player profiles come from all your clients in one list that shows where each item comes from.
entries.v0_10_0_featuredMods: The server mod catalog now highlights JA+, LugorMod, MakerMod and JA++.
entries.v0_10_0_fixes: A message that arrives while a conversation is opening no longer goes missing, the Devices and sessions card no longer shows the previous account after you sign out, and JKHub links in bundles open only jkhub.org pages.
entries.clientImport: Client import now shows category sizes and lets you choose demos, screenshots, configs and pk3 files individually. It can also install a managed engine while keeping a rollback snapshot.
entries.profileImport: A player profile can be created from a game cfg file. JKNet recognizes the player name, model, sabers, blade colors and character tint before opening the usual form.
entries.changelog: The launcher now includes this Changelog page with its complete release history in every interface language.
entries.v0_8_0_portableClients: Existing portable clients can be imported as independent copies, including their mods and media.
entries.v0_8_0_dedicatedServers: Persistent dedicated-server instances keep their own engine, mod, maps, configs and working files, and can be started, stopped and cloned.
entries.v0_8_0_serverTools: Server configs have a full editor, safe imports for major mods and a JKHub catalog of server-side files.
entries.v0_8_0_compatibility: Windows servers choose x86 when an older native mod needs it, understand GameData archives and can extract jampgamex86.dll from pk3 files.
entries.v0_8_0_friendPresence: Friend cards no longer repeat the technical client name next to the status.
entries.v0_7_1_chatSending: Friend messages send again instead of remaining in the Sending state. A lint check now guards the lock pattern that caused the deadlock.
entries.v0_7_0_conversations: Direct chats, groups of up to 20 people and chats for private servers were added.
entries.v0_7_0_windows: Chat can stay in the launcher drawer, be pinned beside the page or open in a separate compact window.
entries.v0_7_0_messages: Messages support replies, reactions, mentions, read status, typing indicators and search across 90 days of history.
entries.v0_7_0_sharing: Attachments and rich cards safely share servers, bundles, JKHub mods, maps, player profiles and configs.
entries.v0_7_0_notifications: Windows notifications, sounds, quiet modes, per-chat settings, tray operation and privacy controls were added.
entries.v0_6_0_hosting: Play with friends starts a private dedicated server from an installed client, with map, mode, bots, limits and access settings.
entries.v0_6_0_network: Guests try local-network addresses first and use the JKNet relay when they are elsewhere, without manual port forwarding.
entries.v0_6_0_invites: Friends can be invited before or during a session. Join chooses the route and password automatically.
entries.v0_6_0_status: Home and Friends show the live server state, players and duration, while closing or updating respects a running server.
entries.v0_5_0_bundles: Bundles combine one or more clients, pinned engine releases, overlays, pk3 files and configs into an installable recipe.
entries.v0_5_0_catalog: The Clients screen gained local drafts and an online bundle catalog with installation progress and integrity checks.
entries.v0_5_0_editor: A full editor can create a bundle from a client, test it locally and publish a first version or an update.
entries.v0_5_0_preview: Bundle descriptions support localized Markdown, images and video links, while file lists show their source and contents.
entries.v0_5_0_management: Authors can manage versions and storage, and administrators can review releases that contain executable files.
entries.v0_4_0_architecture: Engine installation selects the package for the operating system and processor architecture, with safe fallbacks where supported.
entries.v0_4_0_communities: Permanent community pages bring together servers, descriptions, rules, links and recommended JKHub files.
entries.v0_4_0_installAll: Install all and join prepares every recommended file in the chosen client before connecting to a community server.
entries.v0_4_0_maps: Map search understands BSP names, and Base game cards show the levelshots from the player's own game files.
entries.v0_3_0_languages: The launcher was translated into eight interface languages with localized numbers, dates, sizes and durations.
entries.v0_3_0_jediOutcast: Jedi Outcast support was added alongside Jedi Academy, with its own clients, servers, library and game files.
entries.v0_3_0_library: The Library gained a Base game catalog and a searchable local index of the complete JKHub catalog.
entries.v0_3_0_previews: Maps, characters, skins, sabers, weapons and other installed objects gained rich previews, including 3D views.
entries.v0_3_0_playerTools: Player profiles, shared configs, a visual bind editor and the Media bank became dedicated management screens.
entries.v0_3_0_serverBrowser: The server browser gained favorites, history, LAN discovery, saved filters, offline rows and richer context menus.
entries.v0_2_0_players: The server browser separates human players from bots in counts, sorting and the player list.
entries.v0_2_0_filters: A filter can hide servers populated only by bots.
entries.v0_2_0_levelshots: Server rows show map pictures read from the player's own pk3 files without writing to the game folder.
entries.v0_2_0_refresh: The table stays still while a refresh runs, so rows do not move away from the pointer.
entries.v0_1_1_updaterTest: A maintenance release verified the automatic update path without changing launcher features.
entries.v0_1_0_setup: First-time setup finds Jedi Academy game files in Steam and GOG installations or accepts a folder chosen by the player.
entries.v0_1_0_clients: Named clients install OpenJK, EternalJK, TaystJK or jaMME releases and keep their own files and settings.
entries.v0_1_0_servers: The server browser queries public master servers, filters the result and connects with the selected client.
entries.v0_1_0_library: The pk3 library installs files into one client's home folder by drag and drop or a file picker.
entries.v0_1_0_updates: The Windows installer and signed automatic updates distribute JKNet and reject unsigned packages.
